author: Justin Hawkins Rides Again
description:
🎟️ To come and see Justin Hawkins Rides Again LIVE across the UK in January and February, find tickets here:

🎟️ For VIP upgrades: https://thejawsofvictory.com/pages/justin-hawkins-rides-again?srsltid=AfmBOorryy6x7BKwj8HeKF7R1Jdtat6hl3fNPuhRJfMpQWxpCC2o1IqT

I'm on tour with the live version of Justin Hawkins Rides Again...Again and in Glasgow I met up with Dead Pony at the Clyde Rooms. Before I left, I reviewed their new song, Eat My Dust - which comes out today! I didn't know that when I reviewed the track, which becomes clear in this episode. Please, to enjoy! 

To see more from JHRA,  join my Patreon here: http://www.patreon.com/jushawk

For Cameo messages: https://www.cameo.com/justinhawkins

I'm on tour in Australia with The Darkness next month, you can find details here: https://www.thedarknesslive.com/tour-dates/

Get a Justin Hawkins Rides Again T-Shirt & Hoodie here: https://thejawsofvictory
